component.name: Sony Headphones
component.summary: Noise cancelling, ambient sound, EQ and battery from the top bar

description.p: Controls Sony headphones that use the MDR v2 control protocol over Bluetooth: noise cancelling, ambient sound level and focus on voice, the hardware equalizer, and battery level. Settings are stored in the headset. Tested on the WH-1000XM5.
Unofficial. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Sony.
